name: Sunshower Orchards
description: An independent apple orchard in Cornelius, OR, Sunshower Orchards grows Apples, Corn, and Christmas trees. The orchard is busiest in autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
